prompt_text: Write a C solution for the HackerRank problem Triplets.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution counts index-based triplets instead of distinct value-based triplets, leading to overcounting when duplicate elements exist.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Fails to enforce distinct value combinations and treats duplicate indices as separate valid triplets.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Final accumulation loop: ans += smaller_left[i] * greater_right[i]
